content.text: {"rows":[{"source_id":"fr42c-069-0099","target":"— Да, Джон, — живо ответил Гленарван, взволнованный сильнее, чем хотел показать."},{"source_id":"fr42c-069-0100","target":"— Go head! — крикнул Джон инженеру."},{"source_id":"fr42c-069-0101","target":"Пар засвистел в трубах, винт ударил по волнам, и в восемь часов последние вершины острова Табор скрылись во мраке ночи."}],"review":[{"source_id":"fr42c-069-0099","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"Smoothed the participial phrase; kept Glenarvan's quick reply and greater emotion than he wished to show."},{"source_id":"fr42c-069-0100","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"Fixed dialogue punctuation: the draft had a dash plus quotation marks. Kept the source's English 'Go head' form."},{"source_id":"fr42c-069-0101","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"Fixed the tense: 'battit' and 'siffla' are perfective. Kept 'at eight o'clock' and 'shadows of night' accurate, with 'hélice battit les flots' rendered as the screw striking the waves."}]}
